newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota, Nippon Furnace set up joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Toyota, Nippon Furnace set up joint venture.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Monday that it and Nippon Furnace Kogyo Kaisha Ltd had jointly set up a venture firm in the field of thermal engineering.
The new company will manufacture and sell energy-saving gas burners, industrial incinerators and boilers.
The move is part of a 50 billion yen venture fund programme set up by Toyota in July to promote business diversification.
Toyota has provided 85 percent of the new firm's starting capital of 100 million yen, while Nippon Furnace provided 10 percent.
The remainder was provided by Toyota employees who came up with the idea of the new business, the statement said.
